coverage_note: Turns 00:53-1:05:31 read in order. 01:54-03:19 Medi lines are pre-lesson Farsi/garbled (not filed). Engine holes ('[speaking Arabic]') at 42:13-44:09, 45:19-45:28, 47:27, 1:00:56, 1:01:39, 1:02:12; Amal's 'بس فيه error' at 45:00 refers to a lost line, not filed. 26:54 'كم يوم؟ Or كم أيام؟' is a question (E5), not a slip. 29:12 بستناكي->بستناها, 49:51 سنين->سنان, 49:43 الموعد->موعد, 1:00:53 أخد مني->أخذني are his own self-fixes. 21:26 laazem_noun candidate is not a slip (he said لازم أحجز). 27:14 أنا بضل folded into the 27:18 B13 row. 34:38 اللي row: at 35:13 she first seemed to accept it, then ruled 'No اللي' on the 38:23 read-back. Echo candidates reviewed: none is a sound-alike of Arabic (all real English fillers). 09:26 'أنا ما أصل' unclear, skipped. 33:17 أشكي: her chat and sheet also use ashki/bashki, so medium confidence.

rows.amal_said: How do you make قهوة two؟ ... No، it's feminine، so شو.
rows.chat: ana ba2dar a7ki a7san lamma ashrab ahwetain
rows.why: Two of a noun is the dual, not تنين + noun; she prompted, he tried قهوين, she said it is feminine, he got قهوتين.

rows.medi_said: أنا دايمًا، اه، أحكي لك-- أحكيلها
rows.amal_said: بتشرب قهوة؟ كتير.
rows.chat: ana dayman ba7kilha enno heyye bteshrab ahwa kteer
rows.why: Habitual present (dayman) needs b-; her chat has ba7kilha; no voiced fix.

rows.medi_said: اه، هي تشربي، اه، too much قهوة.
rows.amal_said: بتشرب قهوة؟ كتير.
rows.why: He used the bare you-fem form for 'she drinks'; she recast بتشرب (b- plus she-form) and he repeated it.

rows.amal_said: بتشرب قهوة؟ كتير.
rows.why: English dropped into the Arabic sentence and she supplied كتير; sheet row: 'a lot / very / much | Kteer | كتير'.

rows.medi_said: اه، حكيت لك إنه أنا بقدر أدرس أحسن لما
rows.amal_said: أمم، شو حكتلك هي طيب؟
rows.chat: ana 7akaitla 5atibti enno ana ba2dar a7ki a7san
rows.why: He is telling what he told his fiancee (chat: 7akaitla 5atibti) but used the you-ending; she let it pass.

rows.amal_said: طمك؟ ... شو يعني طم؟
rows.why: طم is mouth (sheet 'mouth | Tomm | تم'), he meant stomach; she asked 'شو يعني طم؟' and he fixed to بطني (sheet 'stomach / belly | Bâ6en').
'It hurts' needs the it/he form (her chat beywajje3); بوجع reads as 'I hurt'; could be engine elision.

rows.medi_said: أنا كان لازم تمرنت في الصبح بس ما ما تروحي.
rows.amal_said: ما؟ I didn't go. مش you did-- you don't go.
rows.chat: ana kaan laazem tmarranet fi el-subu7 ma ru7et
rows.why: He used a present you-form for 'I didn't go'; she said 'I didn't go, not you don't go' and he said ما رحت.

rows.medi_said: أنا بأكل نفس إشي أغلب من أيام.
rows.amal_said: نفس. What's the-- شو جمع إشي؟ ... أشياء، نفس الأشياء.
rows.chat: ana baakol nafs el-ashyaa2 a8lab el-ayyaam
rows.why: Singular إشي for 'the same things'; she asked for the plural, he said أشياء, she gave نفس الأشياء (nafs + el-).
rows.english: I eat the same things most days

rows.medi_said: أنا بأكل نفس إشي أغلب من أيام.
rows.amal_said: Most of most, most days. أغلب شو؟ الأيام.
rows.chat: ana baakol nafs el-ashyaa2 a8lab el-ayyaam
rows.why: أغلب is idafa with the definite owner (a8lab el-ayyaam); he said أغلب من أيام then أغلب أيام, she prompted 'أغلب شو؟ الأيام'.

rows.medi_said: اه، تلاتة عشرين ألفين ستة وعشرين.
rows.amal_said: تلاتة وعشرين شو؟ ... تسا. طيب، أتسا.
rows.right: تلاتة وعشرين تسعة ألفين ستة وعشرين
rows.why: Date left out the month (and the و in 23); she asked 'تلاتة وعشرين شو؟' twice and supplied the month (9).

rows.medi_said: عشر دقائق إلا، إلا، إلا ثنتين-- اه، إلا ثلاث؟
rows.amal_said: Mm، بالعكس. ... لا، بالعكس. ... عشرة.
rows.why: Clock order is hour + illa + minutes; she said 'بالعكس' twice and supplied عشرة until he said تلات إلا عشرة.

rows.medi_said: اه، أنا فكرت، اه، إنه الـ، الخفيف، اه، دبا.
rows.amal_said: خفيف or خريف.
rows.why: He said خفيف (light; sheet 'light | 5afeef') for fall; she asked 'خفيف or خريف' and he took خريف (sheet 'autumn / fall | 5areef').

rows.amal_said: B. The first letter is B. ببدأ. So بدأ، yeah.
rows.why: He swapped the letters of بدأ (started), said it three times and asked 'So it's دبا?'; she said the first letter is B, بدأ.

rows.medi_said: بس أنا كنت غلط. بس أنا كـ...
rows.amal_said: هم. شو؟
rows.why: غلط is the noun 'mistake'; 'I was wrong' wants the adjective غلطان (my reading); she did not address it.

rows.amal_said: No. ما هو this appointment or time of something. ... So it's a booking.
rows.why: He gave موعد (appointment) for 'booking'; she said no, that is appointment, and later gave حجز.

rows.amal_said: No. There's a, a specific word we know. ... طلب is order. No. ... The noun is حجز.
rows.why: He used طلب (order) for 'book a room'; she said no, طلب is order, and gave حجز / أحجز (sheet 'i book | Ana ba7jez').
rows.english: I want to book a room

rows.amal_said: mm-hmm. أو we also say view عادي. مع-- بس منظر is masculine. It's not منظرة.
rows.chat: ana biddi el-8urfe ma3 manzar el-shatt.
rows.why: He made the noun feminine; she said 'منظر is masculine, it's not منظرة'.

rows.amal_said: شو بتسأليني؟
rows.why: He added an extra t- to the verb; she recast بتسأليني and he repeated it.

rows.amal_said: أضل.
rows.why: engine wrote بدول for بضل: after ra7 the verb is bare; at 27:14 he said أنا بضل, she said 'I will stay', he said راح بضل, she recast أضل.

rows.amal_said: How do I make يوم to...
rows.why: Two days is the dual يومين, not number + plural; she prompted and he said يومين.

rows.amal_said: بدفع and مش مع. Which one؟
rows.why: Plain present needs b-; she said بدفع and he repeated it.

rows.amal_said: بدفع and مش مع. Which one؟
rows.why: 'Pay with' is بـ not مع; she said 'مش مع' and he said بدفع بـ.

rows.medi_said: أنا لازم أحكي مع مديرك. أنا لازم أشكي.
rows.amal_said: أنا بدي أشتكي.
rows.chat: mar7aba, ana laazem a7ki ma3 mudirek. ana biddi ashki
rows.why: She recast أشتكي (sheet 'complain | Eshki | اشتكي') for his أشكي and he repeated; note her chat and the sheet also have ashki / bashki, so the form is borderline.

rows.amal_said: واحد. One. خلص. So you don't need say one.
rows.why: 'One' is just the singular noun; she said you don't need واحد and he said سألت موظف.

rows.amal_said: استنى شوي. You asked him a question or you asked something of him؟
rows.why: سأل is ask a question; he meant ask someone to do something; she asked which and he switched to طلبت.

rows.amal_said: من؟
rows.why: طلب takes من for the person asked; she prompted 'من؟' and he added من (then the singular الموظف).

rows.amal_said: When أزا؟ ... To come. So it's not to came. So it's to come.
rows.why: After 'asked him to' the second verb is a bare present, not past; she said 'it's not to came, it's to come' and he said يجي.

rows.medi_said: اللي، إجا ... (read-back 38:23: الـ موافظ اللي يجي، موظف اللي يجي)
rows.amal_said: Oh، في error here. ... So you don't need الـ اللي. ... No اللي then. ... لا خلاص إنه يجي.
rows.why: illi (the one who) used for 'asked him to'; on the read-back she said 'No اللي then' and gave إنه يجي.
rows.english: I asked the employee to come

rows.amal_said: هو أبدًا شو؟
rows.why: abadan needs ma on the verb; she prompted 'هو أبدًا شو؟' and he added ما.

rows.amal_said: ما. It's came. He never came. ... Came past.
rows.why: Present form for a past event; she said 'it's came... came past' and he said ما آجه.

rows.amal_said: You didn't like.
rows.why: Complaint about the stay needs past; she said 'You didn't like' (English rephrase) and he said ما حبيت.

rows.amal_said: الأمريكي. ... The American food. الأكل الأمريكي.
rows.why: Adjective on a definite noun takes el- too; she recast الأكل الأمريكي and he repeated.

rows.medi_said: الـ، uh، only الـ- الوحيد أكل.
rows.amal_said: الأكل الوحيد، cuz وحيد is not adjective.
rows.chat: el-akel el-wa7eed illi dall kaan fool
rows.why: Adjective goes after the noun; she recast الأكل الوحيد and he repeated it.

rows.amal_said: تذكرة. تذكرة، تذاكر. ... تذكرة is a ticket.
rows.why: He misread her تذاكر as بتذكّر and then asked what it means; she gave تذكرة / تذاكر = ticket (sheet 'ticket | Tazkara').

rows.medi_said: uh، أنا عادةً أحجز الـ، uh، تذكرة
rows.amal_said: امم، قبل قد إيه ...
rows.why: Habitual 'I usually book' needs b-; her chat has ba7jez, no voiced fix.

rows.medi_said: [speaking Arabic] (engine hole; per her echo: قريبًا من السفر)
rows.amal_said: ما في قريبًا من السفر، قريبًا سفر. Doesn't work. ... قريب من السفر.
rows.chat: ana ba2dar ashterihom 2areeb min yoam el-safra
rows.why: Engine dropped his line; her echo shows he used the adverb قريبًا (soon) for 'close to'; she said it doesn't work, قريب من السفر, then يوم السفر.

rows.amal_said: موعد الدرس.
rows.chat: 3aadatan ana bat3allam a7san lamma maw3ed el-dars ykoon badri
rows.why: First word of an idafa takes no el-; she recast موعد الدرس and he repeated.

rows.amal_said: لما موعد الدرس يكون بدري.
rows.chat: 3aadatan ana bat3allam a7san lamma maw3ed el-dars ykoon badri
rows.why: Habitual 'when the class is early' needs ykoon; she finished the sentence with يكون.
rows.english: when the class time is early

rows.amal_said: موعد دكتور السنان.
rows.why: In a chain only the last noun takes el-; she recast and explained 'the ال is at the end'.

rows.medi_said: ب- بيتغير، بيتغير ... من واحد لتنتين.
rows.amal_said: أول إشي it changed.
rows.chat: maw3ed doktor el-snaan t8ayyar min el-wa7de la-el-tentain
rows.why: He meant it changed; she said 'first thing, it changed' and he moved to the past (كان).

rows.amal_said: تاني إشي، uh، ساعة دايمًا feminine. So مش واحد، شو بتصير؟ ... الوحدة.
rows.why: Clock hours are feminine with el-; she named the rule and he said الواحدة للتنتين.

rows.medi_said: It's تذكرة؟ It's ticket, isn't it?
rows.amal_said: تذكرة، ticket.
rows.why: Asked for 'booking', he offered تذكرة; she said تذكرة is ticket and he moved to حجز.

rows.amal_said: So أخو مرت أخوي. إنت، إنت it's just بالعكس. صح، بس بالعكس.
rows.why: Chain possession runs thing-first (a5u mart a5uy) with mart; she said it is the reverse and explained no extra ending is needed.

rows.medi_said: I don't even remember it now. [speaking foreign language]
rows.amal_said: راكب.
rows.why: He could not recall 'passenger'; she supplied راكب (sheet 'passenger | Raakeb').

rows.medi_said: Is it [speaking foreign language] or [speaking foreign language] ? Okay, I was close.
rows.amal_said: سواق.
rows.why: He could not recall 'driver'; she supplied سواق (sheet 'driver | Sawwaa2').

rows.medi_said: Do you take turns? ... [speaking foreign language]
rows.amal_said: نوخذ just door.
rows.why: He asked how to say take turns (tried Farsi); she gave نوخذ دور / بالدور.

rows.amal_said: إله، إلي، إلك، إله. ... ما إله طعم.
rows.chat: ma ilo ta3em = it doesn't have a taste
rows.why: He did not know ilo (to it / has) and asked; she conjugated إلي إلك إله and explained 'it doesn't have a taste'.

rows.medi_said: [speaking Arabic] (engine hole) ... It took me two hours to make this table.
rows.amal_said: So now أخلص just أعمل. ... أعمل or أخلص just one. Which one؟ ... أخلص.
rows.why: Engine lost his line; her replies show he stacked أعمل and أخلص for one action and she made him keep one (أخلص).
rows.english: it took me two hours to finish this table
rows.proposed_rule: One action, one verb: after a5adni saa3tain la- use a single verb (la-a5alles haadi el-taawla), not two verbs for the same act.
